title: A session waiting on CI subscribes to the PR first; check-ins are the safety net
ruling: Owner 21:39 CST Nov 13, in runner 10's chat, relayed by runner 10 and the consultant (triage did not see it): a session should set a watcher or poll to be woken, not set check-ins, and this needs a guard if the retrospective agrees. The retrospective agrees (consultant 21:41 CST). The ruling states a direction, not the guard's exact form; the form is step ci-wait-subscribes-first.
quote: why are u not setting a watcher and or just polling to be woken? why setting check ins
